docs.text: At least 87 people drowned in the Great Lakes this year, and more than half of the deaths happened in Lake Michigan, according to the Great Lakes Surf Rescue Project. More than 1,300 people have drowned in the Great Lakes since the surf rescue project started collecting data in 2010.
